gen.t: Has a doctor said you have a heart condition or high blood pressure?
Do you feel chest pain at rest or during activity?
Do you ever lose your balance from dizziness or faint?
Do you have a bone, joint, or back problem?
Do you take medication for blood pressure, heart, or blood thinning?
Are you pregnant, or have you given birth in the last 6 months?
Any other reason a doctor said you should not exercise?

fu_heart.t: Has your doctor limited your activity, or said your condition is not well-controlled?
Have you had a heart attack, heart failure, or a cardiac procedure in the last 3 months?

fu_meds.t: Have you started or changed this medication in the last month?

fu_preg.t: Has your obstetric provider cleared you for moderate exercise?
